liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (3 reviews): Front-row listener sang along to Bird Song and says Jerry and Brent laughed in his direction; A newbie asked what the song was called and was told 'Snow and Rain'; the riff stuck in their head all night [13][16][20]
- **Drums** (3 reviews): Flora and Diana's chanting at the start of Drums thrilled this listener; the recording seems to have a cut there; Listener calls the Drums the most spectacular thing they had seen and heard [11][14][17]
- **Candyman** (1 review): Candyman is described as seemingly abbreviated, running about six minutes [21]
- **Built To Last** (1 review): Built To Last is noted as Jerry's 1989 version of the song, the title track of the album [21]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Reviewer found the Rider smokin', with Women Are Smarter following and keeping the second-set energy high [20]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Front-row listener called out for Estimated Prophet and the band played it; it was their first California show [13]
- **Space** (1 review): A full Space came out of Estimated Prophet, with the drummers leaving the stage and then returning for a wild Drums [17]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): A very brief Space after Drums worked as an introduction to Eyes Of The World, followed by a strong finish [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-02-11.140719.sbd.pcm.miller.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 165 min [1]. Said about its sound: The first set was recorded a little hot but remains fairly clean [1]
- **gd89-02-11.sbd.wiley.9203.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 4.06/5 by 18 [6]. Said about its sound: Sound was crisp, clear, well balanced and loud; Reviewer prefers this sound to the other recording, which has a static-like, muffled quality as if a sheath covered the speaker [18][21]
- **gd1989-02-11.fob.french.sirmick.76125.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 156 min [7]. Said about its sound: Brickwalling is present in both sets, more obvious in set one; the oade/schoeps rig also experienced it, though not overbearingly [7]
- **gd1989-02-11.140731.set1.akg.c42.ambient.mics.gans.miller.clugston.flac2496**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 8 songs; 65 min [9]

## Around the show

- Listener stood at the barrier with nobody between them and the stage; a beach ball sat on stage most of set two [14]
- Attendee in the parking lot had glasses broken by thrown keys; a woman in a wedding dress ran in front of the car in Inglewood [16]
- The Forum's seedy back-alley ambience suited the LA vibe; the reviewer moved from nosebleed seats to near the soundboard, and a drunk fell on them [18]
- Drums featured guests Airto Moreira, Flora Purim and Diana Moreira [1]
- The three nights were so loud that the tapers' clothes felt pinned to them [7]
- Airto Moreira, Flora Purim and Diana Moreira joined during the I Will Take You Home segment [7]
- Reviewer calls this their favorite China-Rider, Estimated Prophet and I Will Take You Home; they also knew the 2/10 and 2/12 shows [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-02-11.140719.sbd.pcm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD > PCMSet 2: UltraMatrix SBD > PCM [1]. Also: Uploader credits David Gans for help with this PCM soundboard source [1]
- **gd89-02-11.sbd.wiley.9203.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>MC>DAT>CDR [6]. Also: Reviewer had a good second-generation analog copy of the second set, and thinks this matches a copy stolen years ago [22]
- **gd1989-02-11.fob.french.sirmick.76125.sbeok.flac16**: source: Set one: Sennheiser MKE2002 HRTF headband -> Sony TC-D5M @ 6'5" by Mike FrenchSet two; ~ Schoeps cmc?? cards (caps on bodies, cardioids) ORTF @ 6'4" covered by… [7]
- **gd1989-02-11.140731.set1.akg.c42.ambient.mics.gans.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by David Gans; transferred by Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston; source: Master Audience 4 Track Hi-Fi VHS; AKG C42 mics located mid-side of soundboard > 1st gen Hi-Fi VHS (dubbed by David Gans, January 1991) [9]. Also: This ambient-mic source was the one used for the ultramatrix [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1989-02-11 Great Western LA Forum, Inglewood, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1989-02-11-great-western-la-forum-inglewood-ca-usa/) [24]
